lines.en: By all that is sacred, the darkness beckons from our very doorstep.  Army of Embor, rest will not come until we have cleansed this land in Donar's name.  I give my life for Embor... Donar give us strength!
lines.zh: 诸神啊，黑暗业已兵临城下。 恩博尔的将士们啊，在我们以多纳尔之名净化这片土地之前，我们是无法歇息的！ 我将我的生命献给恩博尔……多纳尔赐予我们力量！

lines.en: No friend of the defenders of Dakur will be left behind!  We shall lay down our lives to defend Duke Jaromir and the innocent people of Embor! Survive for just a little longer, Jaromir...
lines.zh: 达库尔保卫者们的友人不会被弃置不理！ 我们要为保卫贾洛米公爵和恩博尔的无辜子民而献身！贾洛米，一定要撑下去啊……

lines.en: Praise to the heavens, our prayers answered... an army of the divine arrives.  And may my faith be never shaken!
lines.zh: 感谢上天回应了我们的祈求……一支神圣军团到来了。 愿我的信仰永不动摇！
